Name: Postal Gifts
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
This mod adds seven new mails and gifts (for now) that the player can open for surprises!

How to open gifts:
[spoiler]
You can open gifts with scissors or, in this case, the shears tool :P

Hold the shears and right-click on the gift to open it.
[/spoiler]
How to unlock mails:
[spoiler]
Linus - Year 2 to 10, Winter 20th, 5 hearts.
Caroline - Year 2 to 10, Winter 7th, 5 hearts.
Gus - Year 1 to 10, Winter 14th, 5 hearts.
Willy - Year 2 to 10, Winter 11th, 5 hearts.
Evelyn - Year 1 to 10, Winter 3rd, 5 hearts.
Lewis - Year 1 to 10, Winter 10th, Community center is complete.
Krobus - Year 1 to 10, Winter 17th, Krobus first mail received, 5 hearts.

You have until year 10 to fulfill these conditions (I hope that is enough time?)
[/spoiler]
I made this mod because I was trying to learn how mails worked, and I want to make mails for other seasons too.
